quotes.text: For D332899 at revision 61fdeb24a40374feeb64fe1685f402200b2304c5, the AI verification record reports that referencing the status element resolved in the DOM but left getAccessibleFor(select).description empty. A headless check reportedly exposed the localized error when the selector referenced a child span while the outer element retained role=status. For this dialog, verify the accessible description itself; a valid DOM reference alone does not prove that error text is exposed. The record reports local renderer, template, fixture, and test edits with static checks passing. The edited version was not run, acceptance is not recorded, and the evidence assessment remains incomplete. This does not establish a general rule for all status elements.
